headline: Nigerian Governors Launch All Progressives Congress Campaign Teams
seoTitle: APC Launches Campaign Councils in Kogi and Kaduna
metaDescription: Governors Usman Ododo and Uba Sani have inaugurated state-level All Progressives Congress campaign councils to prepare for upcoming general elections.
aiSummaryBullets: Kogi State Governor Usman Ododo has established a campaign council for the upcoming presidential election, appointing himself as the chairman.
Former Senator Smart Adeyemi was selected to serve as the Director-General for the All Progressives Congress campaign operations in Kogi State.
Kaduna State Governor Uba Sani is leading the campaign council in his region, which includes high-ranking officials such as the Speaker and Defence Minister.
aiContextParagraph: As Nigeria prepares for the 2027 general elections, state-level branches of the All Progressives Congress (APC) have begun forming their respective campaign structures. In Kogi State, Governor Usman Ododo officially inaugurated a campaign council, assuming the role of chairman while delegating the position of Director-General to former Senator Smart Adeyemi. Concurrently, in Kaduna State, Governor Uba Sani has taken the lead of the local campaign organization. This Kaduna team features prominent political figures, including the Speaker of the House of Representatives and the Minister of Defence. The councils are designed to coordinate election management and operational activities within these states to support the party's broader national electoral objectives. These recent developments represent early organizational steps by regional leadership to solidify party strategy ahead of the next presidential cycle.
whyItIsViral: This news is receiving moderate attention, having been covered by two independent media outlets with a steady pace of reporting.
